create.name: Kim Newing
create.bio:
Kim Newing, who teaches as Mama Goddess, is a spiritual mentor and meditation teacher for women, living on a small farm outside Brisbane with her husband, their three daughters and a crowd of animals. In her early twenties she worked as an airline purser and travelled widely; at 26 she trained in life coaching, NLP and hypnosis, and a silent meditation retreat at 29 became the turning point of her inner life. Her training since then includes Ericksonian hypnotherapy, master-level NLP, intuitive guidance, feminine embodiment coaching and the Non Linear Movement Method, and she has worked with women for more than twenty years.

Her teaching joins psychology and spirituality, with a focus on intuition, self-trust, the body and the patterns we inherit. Her main programme, Soul Expansion Training, is a twelve-week live group course for women, run online with three calls a month and a week off for integration each month. She also records ten-day audio journeys on intuition and soul purpose, and one-to-one embodiment and deep-dive sessions when her diary allows. On Insight Timer, where she has taught since 2017, her voice-led meditations sit beside retold fairy tales for children at bedtime and courses on embodied intuition and purpose.

courses.title: Soul Expansion Training
courses.description: A twelve-week live online programme for women that works on intuition, self-trust and old patterns through her Embodied Intuition Method. It runs with three group calls a month, a week off each month to put things into practice, recordings, workbooks and a private community, with four months' access.

courses.title: The Intuition Kickstarter Course
courses.description: A ten-day audio course for women who want to stop looking outside themselves for answers and learn to hear their own inner guidance again. Short daily listens build the habit.

courses.title: Knowing Your Soul's True Purpose
courses.description: A ten-day guided audio series of fifteen to twenty-five minutes a day on finding your way back to what gives your life meaning and joy.

courses.title: 1:1 Embodiment and Deep Dive Soul Sessions
courses.description: Private sessions online: a 60-minute feminine embodiment session using body awareness and energy work, or a 90-minute deep dive that blends embodiment, breathwork, NLP and spiritual mentoring. Her one-to-one diary is booked into 2027.

courses.title: Embodying Your Wildly Intuitive Self
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course on how intuition shows up in women and how to live by it, touching on subconscious patterns, shadow work and the Hermetic laws, and ending with connecting to your own inner guidance.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Kim Newing on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Voice-led meditations on self-belief, intuition and raising your energy, plus retold fairy tales for children at bedtime. The single tracks are free to hear.
